request.description: The request type for the IntelliJ debug adapter, always "launch".

mainClass.description: Fully-qualified name of the main class to run (e.g. `com.example.Main` or `MainKt` for Kotlin). If omitted, the IntelliJ server auto-resolves it from the project model.

file.description: Path to the source file declaring the main class. Used to launch directly from a file, and to disambiguate when the main class name is declared in more than one file. Supports ${file}.

args.description: Program arguments passed to the main class.

classPaths.description: Override classpath. If empty, the LSP server resolves it from the project model.

modulePaths.description: Module path entries for JPMS launches. Specify manually; the LSP server does not resolve these automatically.

javaExec.description: Path to the java executable. If empty, the project SDK is used.

cwd.description: Working directory for the launched process. Defaults to ${workspaceFolder}.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the launched process.

request.description: The request type for the IntelliJ debug adapter, always "attach".

hostName.description: Host the JVM is listening on.

port.description: JDWP port the JVM is listening on.
